note: Bundled test IdP for acceptance (ADR-05): our own image `test-idp`, SimpleSAMLphp 2.x release on php:8.3-apache, Apache listening on 8080 as uid 1000, SAML 2.0 only, exampleauth:UserPass with the MOCK users of installer/acceptance/fixtures/idp/mock_users.json. Published on 127.0.0.1 (GRDM_PORT_TEST_IDP, default 8081) over plain HTTP because the browser must POST the SAML Response through it and the acceptance guard allows only http://127.0.0.1 (SPEC-04 section 3.4). Config comes from templates/idp/*.tmpl rendered into runtime/config/idp/{config,metadata,cert}/ at `compose render` (follow-up F-1 in templates/idp/README.md). Secrets that must exist in runtime/.env before render (follow-up F-2, `secrets init`): TEST_IDP_SECRET_SALT, TEST_IDP_ADMIN_PASSWORD, and the self-signed key pairs runtime/config/idp/cert/idp.key (0600) + idp.crt and sp.key (0600) + sp.crt. This template does not reference them with the dollar syntax on purpose: test_secrets checks that every key a top-level template references is generated, and secrets.py is changed in the follow-up, not here. The hardening exception for test_idp in manifest/hardening.json describes the previous Java image and is removed in follow-up F-3 once this image is built; until then compose render still drops user: and read_only for this service. Manifest follow-up F-4: a component `test-idp` of its own (services [test_idp]) so that compose render gives this service its own image instead of the Shibboleth-SP image.
